sections.title: Life cycle and form
sections.text: In this catalogue, Helianthus refers to common sunflower, H. annuus, an annual native to North America. Depending on cultivar, it grows about 0.6–3 m tall.

sections.title: Flower heads and seeds
sections.text: The large flower heads, about 7.5–15 cm across, combine central flowers with yellow outer florets. Mature seeds are eaten and pressed for oil.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The seeds are eaten as food; horticultural sources also describe culinary uses of petals and young buds.
